card.name: Words linking alternative patient conditions
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as "or", "at" and "multiple" that join two alternative conditions or settings, often in indication or trial-population text. Also fires on a blank space before a number in dose or blend lists.

modes.label: Or between conditions
modes.description: The word "or" joins two alternative diagnoses or risk groups.
modes.example: The recommended dose of amlodipine for chronic stable<< or>> vasospastic angina is 5

modes.label: Follow-on qualifier
modes.description: A word like "multiple", "at" or "high" comes right after "or" or "either" and introduces the second option.
modes.example: established cardiovascular disease or<< multiple>> cardiovascular risk factors, diabetic retinopathy

modes.label: Space before a number
modes.description: A blank gap before a figure in a dose, rate or blend table.
modes.example: 1 mL/kg to 2 mL/kg<< >>2 mL/s to 3 mL/s

card.writes: It pushes words like "cycle" and "cycles", which is not clearly tied to these contexts.
card.plain: It fires on little words like "or" that join two alternative conditions, such as stable or vasospastic angina.
